Diwali Special Lakshmi Mantras | Mahalakshmi Ashtakam | Lakshmi Gayatri, Beej Mantra & Kanakadhara Stotram
Celebrate the auspicious festival of Diwali with the divine blessings of Goddess Mahalakshmi.
Immerse yourself in the sacred vibrations of powerful Lakshmi Mantras, Stotrams and prayers that invoke the blessings of Maa Lakshmi, the Goddess of wealth, prosperity, abundance, wisdom and good fortune.
